reference.title: STEPX Neo / Step AOS launch article
reference.visual: Grouped skill rows: icon, name, brief description, overflow; search at bottom. Skills/Agents/AI-apps categories are source product features, not Taku features.

otherReference.visual: Searchable named skill directory with source identity; rankings are not imported into Taku.

findings.finding: Setup instructions and large source buttons push actual skills below the fold.
One install button per skill hides the object identity and descriptive context; no search or detail state.
Dark-mode hints lacked contrast; setup fields belong in a secondary source flow.

implementation.pattern: Native grouped list in existing system drawer
implementation.list: Icon, title, up to two description lines and real install status
implementation.detail: Actual upstream SKILL.md metadata at pinned commit; install action, native enable switch, session selection; provenance and raw instructions collapsed
implementation.search: Local filtering by native name, available descriptions and presentation alias
implementation.categories: Presentation heuristics only; not community-authored tags
limits: No fabricated popularity, reviews or verified publisher badges
No separate Agent or AI-app marketplaces
Pinned archive supplies metadata descriptions; unavailable metadata falls back to a detail retry
implementation.summary: Curated Chinese summaries for common skills; original native description remains expandable
